digest.component_or_area: outbound field mapping and config resolution
propositions: Priority field mapping must be config-driven via per-project priority_map axis in the same manner as status_map in S2, with str-keyed baseline dict and effective_priority_map resolver
Unmapped priority values must drift (omit field, warn once) rather than fail sync, since no priority vocabulary validation axis exists
New per-project str-valued create_defaults axis must be resolved and merged into create payloads for required-beyond-baseline fields, with baseline computed fields winning collisions
Both priority_map and create_defaults kwargs must thread through all create-path carriers (Protocol, Cloud backend, DC backend, leaf bodies) as optional parameters matching status_map pattern
Unmapped priority lookup must return None to signal drift and payload omission, never substituting a default value like Medium
Test doubles and existing **kwargs-based fakes must automatically absorb new optional parameters without modification
